reason: E2 directly supports the key premise that an inverted BCC+B2 microstructure improves ductility, but the hypothesis extends this to the NbMoTaW system and to irradiation tolerance without cited evidence. E1 only compares two different RHEAs and does not address Ti additions, B2 precipitates, or irradiation. No cited evidence supports the claims about Ti-induced B2 formation in NbMoTaW, defect sink efficiency, or retention of high-temperature strength.
premises: Discrete B2 precipitates in a continuous BCC matrix improve room-temperature ductility in RHEAs
Ti addition can promote B2 precipitate formation in NbMoTaW
